mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 400,000) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400,000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profit expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units indicate accelerating residential construction activity that correlates with rising consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS falling > 0.2pp over 3 months) signals monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline > 0.2pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS increasing > 50k in 1 month) indicates improving job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises > 50k, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105 for 3 consecutive months) indicates stable manufacturing output that supports long-term corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains above 105 for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
